answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 33 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. The yarrow register is checked at draw time, wander lists the eligible set, and basalt seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 33 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 37 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
